notes.title: Eko and the Bewitched Lands is now fully compatible with the Steam Deck!
notes.content: [p]Exciting news for all Steam Deck users! We're happy to announce that [i]Eko and the Bewitched Lands[/i] is now fully compatible with the Steam Deck, offering a seamless and optimized experience for handheld play. The game runs smoothly at 60 FPS with full support for the native 1280x800 resolution. All UI elements and controls are fully adjusted for the Steam Deck’s layout, so you can dive straight into Eko's mystical world without any hassle. Enjoy exploring, and as always, we’d love to hear your feedback![/p]

notes.title: Crafting Eko : Embracing Unpredictability, Exploring and Fluid Combat.
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

As we continue developing Eko and the Bewitched Lands, I wanted to share what I love about the games that have inspired us: Hades, The Binding of Isaac, and Tunic. These titles have profoundly influenced our design philosophy, and here's why:

[b]Unpredictability: Every Run Feels Fresh
[/b]
One of the most thrilling aspects of these games is their unpredictability. Each playthrough offers a unique experience, with the potential for an amazing run always on the horizon. This randomness keeps the gameplay exciting and encourages replayability.​

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911128/c9cbcac062b94c741648395c847410064954cdf5.png[/img]

[b]Fluid Combat: Engaging and Responsive Battles
[/b]
Combat in these games is anything but clunky. The controls are responsive, and the action is fluid, making every encounter compelling. When you take a hit, it feels like a personal mistake rather than a flaw in the game design, emphasizing skillful play.​

[b]Discovery of Secrets: Uncovering Hidden Treasures
[/b]
The joy of stumbling upon new secrets—be it hidden rooms, artifacts, or lore—is a significant draw. These elements reward exploration and curiosity, adding depth to the game world.​

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911128/1238a9c0a3429c29605f61b70ea69b1dd91ac228.png[/img]

[b]Multiple Endings: Diverse Conclusions Based on Choices
[/b]
Having different endings based on player choices adds layers to the narrative and encourages multiple playthroughs. It allows players to see the consequences of their decisions, making the experience more personal.​

[b]Customizable Difficulty: Tailoring the Challenge
[/b]
The ability to adjust difficulty ensures that both newcomers and veterans can enjoy the game. Features like "No Fail" modes or adjustable challenges make the game accessible without compromising the core experience.​

[b]Conclusion[/b]

By embracing these elements, we're striving to create a game that offers unpredictability, fluid combat, rewarding exploration, meaningful choices, and adjustable challenges. We believe these features will make Eko and the Bewitched Lands a memorable and engaging experience.​

We'd love to hear your thoughts and feedback. Your support is invaluable as we continue this journey.

Happy exploring!

notes.title: Drawing Inspiration: The Games Behind Eko and the Bewitched Lands
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

As we're developing Eko and the Bewitched Lands, we wanted to share the games that have inspired us along the way. Our journey has been shaped by titles like Hades, The Binding of Isaac, and Tunic. Here's how these games have influenced our work:

[b]Hades: Crafting Rewarding Progression
[/b]
Hades impressed us with its dynamic combat and rewarding progression systems. We've aimed to incorporate that sense of continuous growth and excitement into Eko and the Bewitched Lands, ensuring that each run offers new challenges and rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911128/aa24d8b82c0939dce4f1ff4f6984285a2d3ae3fc.jpg[/img]

[b]The Binding of Isaac: Embracing Procedural Exploration
[/b]
The unpredictable nature of The Binding of Isaac's procedurally generated maps has deeply influenced our approach to exploration. In our game, we've implemented similar procedural generation techniques to keep each adventure fresh and engaging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911128/086a23209f92440dbdffdf20ae78e484cd08d651.png[/img]

[b]Tunic: Crafting Visuals and Atmosphere
[/b]
The enchanting visuals and atmospheric world of Tunic inspired us to craft a vibrant and immersive environment. We've strived to create a world that invites players to explore its secrets and fully immerse themselves in the experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911128/712ab15182f91816dbc2ebdb58bd7e91f676acf4.jpg[/img]

[b]Conclusion[/b]

By blending elements from these influential games, Eko and the Bewitched Lands aims to offer a unique mix of rewarding progression, unpredictable exploration, and captivating visuals. We're excited to bring this experience to life and invite you to join us on this adventure.​

Stay tuned for more updates, and feel free to share your thoughts and feedback. Your support is invaluable as we continue to develop Eko and the Bewitched Lands.

Happy exploring!

notes.title: Request access to the playtest NOW!
notes.content:
We are glad to announce the first ever playtest of our game! 

[b]About the playtest[/b]
This test is mostly focused on performance and gameplay feel.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Combat system
[*] Two weapons (bow and sword)
[*] Two worlds (dungeon and forest)
[*] 8 Enemies
[/list]

After a few months of development the first playtest demo is ready, it's in a very early stage but we wanted to let you try it and start gathering feedback to improve it further.
